name: v6-c-idioms
note: V6 iteration 1, data only. Arm C replaces most of the v5 fine-tuning mix (concepts the round-54 checkpoint has seen ~54 times, loss ~0.01) with the idiom curriculum (ycode.lm.idioms, idioms-v1): 233 verified programs from 64 families of general idioms, 2 write + 1 bug-fix example each, several phrasings, implementations and prompt templates, none a near-twin (same AST skeleton) of any held-out item. Legacy kept at 1 write + 1 bug fix per concept, 1 novel exercise per exercise, 100 replay rows. Recipe identical to control A of v51-m3 (same seeds), so C vs A isolates the data.
decision: Pre-registered before any V6 result. Primary metric all_clean = clean dev (/44) + unseen-v1 (/53) + unseen-v2 (/71, written independently, frozen before this data was built), out of 168. A candidate replaces round 54 only if, over its seeds: every seed beats round 54's all_clean, the mean gain is >= 3 items, and no failure category loses >= 3 clean items that round 54 passes (items_lost rule). C vs A (same recipe, existing A runs) is compared on unseen_clean, the metric both have. The benchmark is reported, never used to decide.
